title: Higher direct image stalk over a field via algebraic closure
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $L$ an algebraic closure of $K$, and $a:X\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ a finite-type morphism. Let $F$ be a torsion abelian etale sheaf on $X$ and $q\geq0$. With geometric stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], there is an additive equivalence $(R^qa_*F)_{\operatorname{Spec}L}\simeq H^q(X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}\operatorname{Spec}L,F|)$. Torsion has the local-section meaning [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf].

proof.text: Finite type over the Noetherian field K makes X locally Noetherian. Thus X and a to the affine base are quasi-separated; quasi-compactness is assumed. This supplies the qcqs hypothesis for the stalk formula.

Apply strictHenselization_chart_maximalIdeal in the identity affine chart of Spec K. The unique prime of K is zero, so its extension, the maximal ideal of the strict henselization C, is zero. IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq makes C a field. Its residue map is injective and surjective, hence a ring equivalence; transfer the proved separably closed residue-field instance back along this equivalence. The project strictHenselizationRing and strictHenselizationScheme are compatibility abbreviations for the upstream ring and strictLocalization in the published build.

The identity pointed etale neighbourhood of Spec K gives the canonical map K to C. SpecPointedEtaleNeighborhood.ι_comp_strictHenselizationEval proves that its composite with evaluation C to L is the given algebraMap K L. Use the induced algebra structures and this equality to supply IsScalarTower K C L. Algebraicity of L over K gives algebraicity over C by Algebra.IsAlgebraic.tower_top. Since C is separably closed, Mathlib Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isPurelyInseparable_of_isSepClosed gives purely inseparable L/C. Algebra.IsUniversalHomeomorphism.of_isPurelyInseparable makes Spec of the evaluation a universal homeomorphism.

Apply strictHenselizationStalkFormula to a,s,F,q. Convert ordinary right derived direct image to bounded-below derived homology via homologyRightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleFunctorIso. The formula gives an isomorphism to derived global sections on X×_(Spec K) Spec C. Convert derived homology of global sections to ordinary right derived sections and then Ext cohomology using Sheaf.nonempty_rightDerived_sections_obj_iso_functorH.

Let h:Spec L to the strict localization be Spec of evaluation; its composite with the structural morphism is the geometric point s, by spec_map_strictHenselizationEval_comp_strictLocalizationToBase. Construct g:X_L to X_C by pullback.lift. Cancel the right pullback square with IsPullback.of_right to prove that g is the base change of h. Base-change stability gives IsUniversalHomeomorphism g. Compose the strict-localization additive equivalence, Etale.cohomologyEquiv g, and the image under Sheaf.functorH of the inverse component of upperStarComp identifying the iterated pullback with the restriction to X_L. All choices are inside proofs of propositions; no new definition chooses data from an unproved existence theorem.

theorem nonempty_addEquiv_sheafFiber_rightDerived_lowerStar_of_isAlgClosure
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [IsAlgClosure K L] [IsAlgClosed L] {X : Scheme.{u}} (a : X ⟶ Spec (.of K))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType a] [QuasiCompact a]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hF : F.IsTorsion)
    (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty
      ((((Scheme.pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
          (((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} a).rightDerived q).obj F)) ≃+
        Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (pullback.fst a (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))))).obj F) q)
lean.note: The explicit IsAlgClosed L instance is redundant with IsAlgClosure K L; it makes elaboration of the geometric point independent of reverse instance search for K.
